Guardians of the Cove

Cathedral Cove, Coromandel, New Zealand

NK
Nathan Kavumbura
Photographer

A sea stack standing sentry over turquoise water and pale cliffs — one of the most photographed coves in the country, and still worth the walk in. I shot two versions of the same shot; this is the short exposure, and the other is a long exposure using a 10-stop ND filter.

LocationCathedral Cove, Coromandel, New Zealand
Date capturedNovember 13, 2018
CameraCanon EOS 7D Mark II
Lens17-50mm
Focal length17mm
Aperturef/11
Shutter speed1/1250s
ISO100
